principles: CARRIER-CELL-V1 is the only production voice architecture baseline; overlays do not change voice authority.
RustPBX owns Call, Business Dialog, Logical Media Graph, Media Plan, directed Media Edge classification and Backend-binding commit.
Backend implementations may coexist, but each committed directed Media Edge has exactly one active writer protected by a writer fence.
RTPengine is the long-lived default ordinary RTP/RTCP/SRTP Backend; phase-one voice-media-rs is embedded in the Unified RustPBX Process for decode-required Edges.
POC components are benchmark-only, disabled by default, and excluded from production delivery.
Replacement periods are time-bounded and end with removal of the old component.
Every production image rendered by the iveKit Chart uses an immutable sha256 digest.
